sentences.en: Who dines at this club on Christmas but lonely bachelors?
sentences.zh: 在圣诞节这间俱乐部里吃饭的都是孤独的单身汉吗？

sentences.en: If he were a bachelor, I would marry him.
sentences.zh: 如果他是个单身汉的话，我就会嫁给他。

sentences.en: All the men in our club are bachelors.
sentences.zh: 我们俱乐部里的所有男人都还是单身状态。

senses.zh: 单身汉; 学士(仅用于头衔或固定表达且B大写)
